title: BEASTARS
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a modern society of talking animals where eating meat is illegal, Legoshi, a timid gray wolf at a boarding school, is shaken when an alpaca classmate is killed and eaten. His feelings for Haru, a rabbit, and his rivalry with Louis, an ambitious red deer, draw him into the conflict between carnivores and herbivores, a black market in meat and a lion-led crime syndicate.
life_message: It holds up mastering one's own instincts, understanding across social divides and taking responsibility for one's nature rather than letting it rule.
